I couldn't find a ticket number for a Tamsin Cold Chain gate kiosk outage. I've told Ilse that in a reply to her message in #north-team.

- **The only gate kiosk ticket I found is #PD-4492, and it belongs to Quarrendon Freight Lines.** Their contact, Thea Ramaswell, filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at their Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages telling them which dock door to use. Support fixed it that same evening.
- **Tamsin has two other problems on record, neither with a ticket number:**
  - the cold-load temperature check times out when drivers check in at the Tacoma yard;
  - a report export stalled at Tacoma on 3 Oct 2025.

I told Ilse that if #PD-4492 is the one she means, it goes on the Quarrendon tracker instead. If it isn't, Dana Okafor is the one to ask, since she has the Tamsin account.

I only looked where Ilse herself has access: the North channels, the incident room she's in, and the public files, which include the North team summaries. There are no Tamsin account files in the shared drive that she can open.
